critical_code_review_comments: No ownership leak, pagination flaw, or legitimate-account-mis-repair case found. The repair criteria correctly require upgradedAt + upgradedFrom + current renewalPriceUsd == old plan's list price AND != new plan's list price, and skip any account whose planChangeHistory contains an 'api' entry after upgradedAt or that is deleted/terminated/suspended-forever/promo (renewalPriceUsd==0 or price flagged non-standard). Compare-and-set via updateOne({_id, renewalPriceUsd:current}) makes re-apply a no-op and avoids races with concurrent admin edits.
